Job Description:
 
 Our Opportunity 
 Chewy is seeking a motivated Software Engineer I to join our Supply Chain IT Domain Services team in Plantation, FL or Boston, MA.

 This team owns a suite of critical services that support inventory visibility, purchase order and transfer workflows, electronic data exchange, vendor compliance, and operational analytics across Chewy’s supply chain network. These systems span distributed services and data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch processing.

 As an early career engineer, you will work with experienced engineers to design, build, test, deploy, and support reliable software. You will take ownership of well-scoped work while developing strong engineering, operational, and business fundamentals.

 This is not a purely backend role. You’ll contribute across backend services, APIs, data workflows, and user-facing applications when needed, while learning to deliver complete solutions in a complex, system-heavy environment.

 What You’ll Do 
 Develop and maintain software using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and related technologies with guidance from experienced engineers
 Deliver results on well-scoped features and technical improvements from implementation through testing, deployment, and production validation
 Build and support APIs, event-driven integrations, data workflows, and, when needed, user-facing applications
 Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team engineering standards
 Create automated unit and integration tests and help improve the team’s testing and delivery practices
 Operate in the details by using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and runbooks to troubleshoot issues and improve reliability and performance
 Participate in production support and on-call responsibilities with documented procedures, mentoring, and team support
 Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated output
 Put customers first by partnering with product, program, business, and engineering teams to understand needs and deliver practical supply chain solutions; earn trust by communicating progress, risks, and blockers early
 Apply spec-driven development (SDD) practices, with guidance, to translate requirements and acceptance criteria into reviewed designs, implementation plans, discrete tasks, tests, and delivered code
 Act as an owner for assigned work and contribute to operational excellence by improving documentation, observability, support readiness, and production stability
  
 What You’ll Need 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 Foundational programming experience through professional work, internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, or substantial personal projects
 Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language and the ability to learn Java and Spring Boot
 Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, debugging, and software testing fundamentals
 Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, source control, and modern software development practices
 Exposure to cloud-based application development and an interest in building on AWS
 Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask effective questions, discuss alternatives openly, apply feedback, and commit to team decisions once aligned
 Exposure to SDD workflows that move from requirements and acceptance criteria through design, tasks, implementation, and validation
 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a team
 Accountability for assigned work and willingness to communicate progress, risks, and blockers early
 Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while balancing delivery, learning, and quality
  
 AI and Modern Development Experience 
 We are looking for engineers who are interested in applying AI pragmatically in development workflows. This may include:
 Using approved AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Copilot to improve development efficiency 
 Validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation before use 
 Using reviewed specifications as the source of truth for AI-assisted planning and implementation, then validating the result against requirements, acceptance criteria, and tests 
 Recognizing when human review, security controls, and engineering judgment are required 
  
 Bonus 
 Internship, co-op, or project experience developing cloud-based applications with AWS
 Exposure to Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems, data pipelines, or full-stack development using React or Vue
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers, observability tools, or agile delivery practices
 Interest in supply chain, logistics, inventory systems, e-commerce, or high-volume operational systems
  
  
The base salary range for this role is $92,500 - $160,000.00. The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

 
 We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com. 
 
 Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations. 
 
 Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com .
